summary: Finalise provisioning declaration and package-local verify resolution (issue 356): rcf build finalise accepts --provision-mode <run|skip> and forwards it to the fresh verify subprocess, the finalise report stamps provisioning.mode on completed runs and launch failures, a provisioning blocked-reason surfaced by finalise names only remedies finalise accepts (or the verify-direct route), detectVerify prefers the verify entry of the package finalise runs from over PATH, and the report records the resolved verify command and its version.
notes: Three-hand fix per the RCF-separation ruling 2026-10-13: hand 1 lands US-16505, TS-250 and the red tests; hand 2 makes them pass and updates docs/verify-reference.md, the finalise help and the CHANGELOG; an independent gate reviews both. Code Nodes land with hand 2.
title: FBS-217 finalise --provision-mode forwarding, provisioning.mode stamp, available-remedy blocked reasons, package-local verify resolution with command and version recorded
